system.description:
7th Level Clan Feature

The Weapons you wield while well-crafted have always been missing something. Something that makes it feel yours. By spending 1 Downtime, you are able to perform a Hoshigaki ritual, hunting down different aquatic life and using their remains to enhance the weapons you utilize in combat. Select two of the following weapon grafts, which you use to enhance your weapon with, granting it their listed effects. A weapon can never have more than 2 grafts at a time, and you can only have a single weapon grafted at once. Any new grafts you place on a weapon with them, causes the previous ones to be dispelled.

Raking Dermis (Shark Skin). This weapon gains Pierce 2, and it can deal either slashing or piercing damage.

Wing Guard (Manta). This weapon gains Blocking 1, if it didn’t already. You can now, as a reaction to taking damage, use this weapon to parry some incoming damage, reducing the damage you take by an amount equal to its [Weapon Damage].

Sawtooth (Sawfish). Once per turn, when you deal [Weapon damage] to a creature with temporary hit or chakra points, you reduce them to 0, before applying damage.

Scale Plate (Coelacanth). This weapon gains the Fortified armor property.

Tiger Pattern (Tiger Shark). On your turn, if you hit two or more creatures, you gain +2 DR for each creature hit, until the beginning of your next turn.

Marlin Imprint (Marlin). Attacks with this weapon while underwater gain 2 ranks of Mastery.

Angler Lure (Anglerfish). As a Bonus action, you can force a creature in range to make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure they gain 1 rank of Shaken and they have disadvantage on attacks targeting creatures other than you until the end of their next turn.
